sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 native model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened the native page on October 27. It lists the exact grok-build-0.1 model, 256,000 context, text/image input, reasoning/tools, and legacy Code Fast aliases, but no total or active parameter count or named counted base. The exact embedded object from the original audit supplies TEXT/IMAGE inputs, TEXT output and true functionCalling, structuredOutputs and reasoning flags.

sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 on API, May 29, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete May 29 original announcement freshly fetched October 27. It identifies grok-build-0.1 as the coding model trained for agentic tasks and the model powering Grok Build at launch; it supplies neither total/active size nor a named base-model relationship.

sources.title: Release notes: Grok Build beta and Build 0.1 early access
sources.evidence: Fresh HTML independently fetched: May 14 announces the Grok Build harness beta; May 19 names the exact grok-build-0.1 model and early access. These are earlier milestones than the May 29 public API beta. No April 16 model release entry appears.

sources.title: May 15, 2026 Model Retirement
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: the official guide explicitly recommends migrating from grok-code-fast-1 to grok-build-0.1 and says requests are routed there after May 15. This is a deployment replacement, not an assertion of unchanged weights or fine-tuning from Code Fast. Its timing remains earlier than the May 19 early-access entry and does not resolve the exact first public day.

sources.title: Chat with Files
sources.evidence: Attached files automatically activate document-search tools and an agentic workflow. PDF attachment support is not an additional native model modality.

sources.title: Enterprise terms, May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Release-period terms grant limited hosted service access. Section 4 reserves the underlying technology and intellectual property to xAI or suppliers; no weight redistribution license is granted.

sources.title: xai-org public checkpoint inventory
sources.evidence: Fresh official-organization inventory contains Grok-1 and Grok-2, not Grok Build 0.1. Corroborates hosted distribution alongside the model announcement and terms, rather than proving a universal negative alone.

sources.title: Grok Build is Now Open Source, July 15, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the full July 15 original on October 27. The published source is explicitly the agent loop, tools, terminal UI and extension system; local-first support points the harness at a separate local inference engine. It releases neither Grok Build 0.1 weights nor parameter specifications.

sources.title: Safety and model-card index
sources.evidence: Current primary index provides Grok 4.5/4.6/4.7 and earlier Grok cards but no exact Grok Build 0.1 card. No exact-model technical report was obtained. October 27 re-audit attempted a new direct fetch but received HTTP 403; the earlier successful index read is historical, while original linked cards s10-s12 were freshly fetched and rechecked.

sources.title: Grok 4.5 model card, revision July 20, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the full 29-page original text fetched October 27. The distribution section identifies Grok 4.5 as the newer Grok Build harness default, and evaluation passages use that harness. No exact Build 0.1 mention, total/active count or counted base relationship appears; the new default is not Build 0.1 lineage.

sources.title: Grok 4.6 model card, revision August 17, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the full 42-page original text fetched October 27. Introduction identifies Grok 4.6 as part of the 1.5T-scale family and an extension of Grok 4.5; page 6 identifies it as the Grok Build harness default. No exact Build 0.1 mention or active count appears, and the named 4.5/4.6 family does not establish Build 0.1 size.

sources.title: Grok 4.7 model card, September 21, 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the full 30-page original text fetched October 27. Its distribution section identifies Grok 4.7 as the Grok Build harness default, and later evaluations explicitly use that harness. No exact Build 0.1 count or named counted base appears.

sources.title: Imported Models.dev entry
sources.evidence: Upstream supplies April 16 and PDF modality but no primary support for the date. Used only to identify the imported assertions being corrected.

sources.title: Grok Build 0.1 provider documentation
sources.evidence: Provider documents 256K, text/image input, reasoning and tools, with a May 20 provider release date. That listing date is distinguished from native early access and public beta milestones.

sources.title: Third-party reporting of an unattributed size claim
sources.evidence: Freshly read the complete article fetched October 27, explicitly as SECONDARY reporting. Its 309B total / 15B active claim is attributed to a third-party TypingMind/OpenRouter listing and expressly described as unattributed and unconfirmed by xAI. No original measurement, developer disclosure or counted named-base relationship supports it; reject both numbers. Its stronger lineage interpretation is not adopted.

sources.title: Original Artificial Analysis comparison: Grok Build 0.1 0616 and Step 3.7 Flash
sources.evidence: Fresh direct HTML read and table-cell extraction on October 27. In the table headed Grok Build 0.1 0616 / Step 3.7 Flash, the Total parameters row is blank / 198B and Active parameters is blank / 11B. No Build count is supplied. This original benchmark publisher page is corroborative only: its target is the named June 16 snapshot, its specification metadata is not an xAI disclosure, and blank cells do not prove universal nondisclosure.

name.note: Exact native API model name; distinguish it from the Grok Build application.

developer.note: Original xAI developer attribution; current SpaceXSI branding does not turn it into a different developer record.

family.note: Retain the normalized Grok Build model-line label; this is catalog grouping, not a claim about shared neural architecture.

release_date.note: May is supported, but the exact first public day is unresolved: May 14 harness beta, routing after May 15, May 19 exact-model early access, May 20 provider listing and May 29 public API beta. The April 16 import has no verified release evidence. Month precision avoids selecting one rollout milestone as an unsupported first day.

open_weights.note: Hosted proprietary model. July open-source harness code does not release its weights; no Build 0.1 checkpoint found in the official public distribution inventory.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-model classification under release-period terms. Do not transfer the harness source-code license to the model.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 review found no supported nominal total for exact Build 0.1 or a counted, explicitly named unchanged base. Current Code Fast routing and later Grok harness defaults do not supply model lineage. The unattributed 309B claim remains rejected; the original AA June-snapshot comparison has a blank total cell.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh active-count and later original comparison searches found no supported activated-parameter count. The original AA June-snapshot comparison leaves active size blank; later xAI cards describe other models in the Build harness. The unattributed 15B claim remains rejected, with no inference from throughput, total size or API request settings.

architecture.note: No primary neural-network architecture disclosure found after exact-model training/interpretability research and later-card checks. Agent harness architecture and internal API algorithm labels are not neural topology. The unattested MoE/hybrid-attention claim is not adopted.

context_window.note: Exact native model object and page agree on 256,000 tokens. The commercial 200K long-context pricing threshold is not the maximum context.

modalities.note: Native modalities from the exact model payload. Remove PDF because file attachment processing uses document-search tools.

reasoning.note: Exact native feature flag is true; this does not assert an adjustable effort setting or availability of visible internal reasoning.

tool_call.note: Exact functionCalling flag and original announcement support function/tool calling.

description.value: Coding model trained for agentic software engineering, with text and image input, reasoning, and tool calling.
description.note: Neutral documented purpose and capabilities; remove unqualified speed framing.

sources.label: Release notes: Grok Build beta and Build 0.1 early access
Grok Build is Now Open Source, July 15, 2026

patch.notes: Released in May 2026; the exact first public day is unresolved across the harness beta, compatibility routing, early access and public API beta milestones. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed in the reviewed originals; no counted base is identified. Unattributed 309B/15B figures are unverified. Neural architecture is undisclosed. The open-source Grok Build harness and its newer default models are separate from Build 0.1; Code Fast aliases are compatibility redirects. Native inputs are text and images; PDF attachments use document-search tools.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after reopening native specifications, the original launch and harness release, and later original xAI cards. No counted named-base relationship or usable original comparison count was found; secondary 309B/15B claims remain unverified. The other twelve assessments, including May release precision, proprietary licensing, 256K context, text/image input, reasoning and tools, are unchanged.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Retain parameters_b=null and active_parameters_b=null, both undisclosed, after separate fresh review.

access_limitations: New direct safety-index request returned HTTP 403; prior source s9 remains a historical access. All three original later cards were freshly retrieved October 27 and independently rechecked.
parameter_reaudit.total_assessment: No developer nominal total or explicit counted named-base relationship found. API migration and later harness defaults do not establish that relationship. Reject the unconfirmed 309B claim.
parameter_reaudit.active_assessment: No developer active disclosure or later original research comparison supplying an applicable activated-count convention found. Fresh exact-model arXiv/ACL/Hugging Face and developer searches produced no usable research lead. The inspected AA June-snapshot table has a blank active cell, not a size. Reject the unconfirmed 15B claim.
parameter_reaudit.lineage_assessment: The May launch names the same model powering the launch-period Grok Build app, without identifying any counted base. The migration guide replaces Code Fast; later cards replace the harness default. Neither is an unchanged-base or posttraining relationship for Build 0.1.
parameter_reaudit.stop_reason: Bounded fresh total, active, original-comparison and named-lineage searches completed with no credible positive parameter lead remaining.
